name: Dispelling Doorway Trap
body:
Dispelling Doorway Trap
CR 4

When a creature with a magical aura (such as one carrying magic items or has an ongoing spell effect) passes through this doorway, this trap activates. It casts dispel magic as a 5th level caster, attempting to dispel the spell or effect with the highest caster level. The arcane switch is actually a simple wave of a hand through the doorway by a creature with no magical aura. If this is done, any number of creatures with a magical aura may pass through the doorway for the next 3 rounds.

Trap cost: 750 gp.

Type magic; Perception DC 28; Disable Device DC 28

EFFECT

Trigger proximity (detect magic); Reset none; Bypass arcane switch (Knowledge (arcana) DC 25 to determine)

Effect spell effect (dispel magic, CL 5th, targeted dispel)
